messages:
ana: FYI a customer deployed our JS SDK to Cloudflare Workers and hit 'require is not defined' because dist/cjs was loaded. We need a plan for ESM/Edge compatibility.

tom: Agreed. Short term: add conditional exports in package.json so import -> dist/esm, require -> dist/cjs, worker -> dist/esm/worker-entry.js.

sree: Also update quickstarts from CJS to ESM examples. Many users copy-paste require() and then complain. Add an Edge quickstart showing env injection.

tom: Build changes: tsup should emit a worker-targeted ESM bundle without node shims and a CJS wrapper that preserves module shape (exports.default = module.exports).

ci-bot: queued canary test 0.13.1-canary.1 for Node16/18, Bun, and Workers emulator. Will post results.

ana: one more: publish flat dist/index.d.ts and mirror types in exports map to avoid editor resolution issues.

sree: plan: single package with conditional exports, edge ESM build, updated quickstarts, types mapping, CI smoke tests. If we hit resolver regressions, cut a -compat package as fallback.

tom: I'll open the package.json PR and ping for reviews.

ci-bot: smoke tests started.
